title: Viettel My Agent
overview: Production AI platform processing 50K+ monthly conversations with real-time streaming, document knowledge management, and zero-downtime deployments on Kubernetes.
challenge: Build a ChatGPT-like interface supporting high-frequency SSE streaming updates (~60fps), artifact rendering (files, video, HTML), and low-latency LLM responses while maintaining 99.9% uptime across distributed Kubernetes clusters.
contributions: Engineered ChatGPT/Claude-style web interface (React) with async chunk processors consuming SSE streams for smooth 60fps artifact rendering and interactive notebook-style document search.
Designed API Gateway service (NestJS) handling 1000+ req/s with Redis caching (2-tier: query cache + document cache), reducing LLM calls by 65% and response latency to <200ms.
Built visual node-based CMS configuration tool (Vue.js) enabling non-technical staff to design multi-step chatbot workflows without touching source code — reusable pattern for internal tools.
Implemented document knowledge management system: ingestion pipeline, semantic indexing, and retrieval optimization for LLM context windows.
Enhanced CI/CD using GitLab CI multi-stage pipelines, reducing deployment time from 15m to 3m with zero-downtime blue-green deployments via ArgoCD.
Set up comprehensive monitoring: Prometheus for metrics (p99 latency, throughput), Grafana dashboards for real-time observability, enabling quick debugging of distributed issues.
